notes: SGTF is a lab proxy that defines likely JN.1 case status, so it is treated as a case definition, not a procedure. Age-group VE compares only two groups (18–49 vs ≥50), so it has no groupwise entry. Secondary analyses with alternative reference groups are reported only in a supplement.
view_issues: Prepass 'fisher' (Thermo Fisher Scientific) and 'weighting' ('inherently weighted') are false hits. Table 1 CSV gives laboratory-based NAAT controls as 1,582 in the subanalysis, against n = 1,520 in the header. The Summary's '54% increased protection' wording misstates VE.
